project: YOLOv1: detection, confidence and grid limits
primary_question: How much do confidence targets and augmentation affect localization-aware detection scores under a fixed training protocol?
paper_limitation: One class distribution and one assigned object per grid cell limit nearby and small-object representation.
contribution: Auditable grid-collision accounting, repaired VOC evaluation, and a controlled IoU-versus-unit-confidence ablation protocol.

historical_assets.status: Historical training diagnostics; not a held-out benchmark result

synthetic_demo.label: Geometric illustration; no model inference
synthetic_demo.behavior: Both centers occupy the same grid cell. The training encoder keeps one target; the evaluator retains both ground-truth objects.

validation.cpu_scope: VOC metric and data invariants tested without Torch
validation.torch_tests: Pending installation of PyTorch in the local validation environment
validation.voc_dataset_audit: Command ready; official data not present locally
